mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies and a temperature of 82 degrees at Verona Community Park, feeling closer to 90. Expect rain tonight with an overnight low of 73 degrees. Also, under our third-quarter moon tonight, the International Space Station will be visible at 3:35 AM, rising over Middleton near Verona High School and traveling east toward Fitchburg about halfway up the sky.

In local news, the Military Ridge State Trail paving project is moving forward to improve year-round accessibility, requiring a trail closure between Lincoln and South Franklin Street from mid-September to mid-November for bridge work. Additionally, a new sculpture titled Tai Chi Animal Frolics is now on display at Century School Park. Carved from a fallen ash tree by local artists, this beautiful piece depicts traditional Tai Chi movements.
For local events, you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness or Hop Haus Trivia today. Tomorrow, get ready for fantastic live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Lou-ee.

In the police weekly report, officers successfully saved a life on Tuesday, August twenty-fifth. Responding to a medical emergency on Enterprise Drive, an officer used an automated external defibrillator on a pulseless man, successfully restoring his pulse before medical help arrived.
Culver's is currently open until 10 PM tonight, so stop by to treat yourself to today's delicious flavor of the day, Snickers Swirl.
